component.name: Dualfile
Dualfile
component.summary: Browse and manage files in two panes
Dateien in zwei Fenstern durchsuchen und verwalten

description.p: Dualfile is a two-pane file manager for Linux with tabs, keyboard controls and background file jobs. Browse local folders, archives and remote servers, and move files between them.

Dualfile ist ein Zwei-Fenster-Dateimanager für Linux mit Tabs, Tastatursteuerung und Dateioperationen im Hintergrund. Durchsuche lokale Ordner, Archive und entfernte Server und übertrage Dateien zwischen ihnen.
Connect to SFTP, FTP/FTPS and SMB locations, compare and synchronize folders, or rename multiple files with a preview. The interface is available in English and German.
Verbinde dich mit SFTP-, FTP/FTPS- und SMB-Zielen, vergleiche und synchronisiere Ordner oder benenne mehrere Dateien mit Vorschau um. Die Oberfläche ist auf Deutsch und Englisch verfügbar.

ul.li: Linux application ID is now com.dualfileapp.Dualfile in preparation for Flatpak (#29). Existing window state, managed autostart modes and start-menu entries are migrated without overwriting newer state or removing foreign files. A legacy D-Bus endpoint prevents old and new versions from running together.
Autostart help now points to Settings → General / Einstellungen → Allgemein (#32).
Settings reorganised into eight sections with a sidebar, search, a Modified filter, per-setting reset and a live file-list preview (#27).
Link to the manual (wiki) under Info & Help, following the effective interface language.
Missing terminal-shell values now show login, the same fallback the backend uses; the settings dialog's defaults match the backend's.
Unset pane colours show an empty swatch; tint opacity is disabled until a colour is selected.
Accent hex input accepts values without a leading #.
Sidebar width is constrained to 160–400 px with a slider, and restoring hidden entries reports when nothing is hidden.
Pane colour only tints the file list (#25).
Permissions, uid and gid columns can be shown individually (#26).
